stories.title: Developer seeks costs from Flintshire council over refused Ewloe housing scheme
stories.summary: A developer is asking for Flintshire County Council to pay its costs after councillors refused 315 homes in Ewloe against the advice of their own planning officers. stories.title: Food Standards Agency repeats egg advice as salmonella outbreak linked to imported eggs grows
stories.summary: Pregnant women, young children and older people in Flintshire are being advised to avoid dishes made with raw or lightly cooked egg when eating out. The advice comes from the Food Standards Agency, which is investigating a salmonella outbreak alongside the UK Health Security Agency. stories.title: A541 at Rhydymwyn to close overnight for three weeks of resurfacing
stories.summary: Overnight closures will be in place on the A541 at Rhydymwyn for around three weeks from Thursday 3 September while Flintshire County Council resurfaces the road. stories.title: Flintshire youth services praised for offering great support and opportunities
stories.summary: Youth services in Flintshire have been given a clean bill of health – with Estyn inspectors praising the opportunities, support and inclusivity the authority’s team provides. stories.title: Up to £110 a year off your bill, with a solar panel you plug into a socket
stories.summary: Plug-in solar panels become legal to buy and use across Great Britain from Thursday, including in Flintshire. The UK Government says the panels could save households up to £110 a year. They plug directly into a socket rather than being wired in by an installer, so there is no installation cost.
